    - Have you seen the cliff south of the quarter? Sound rock all the way down. A stairway there, landings cut into the face: the first new route to the valley floor since Durra's Stair. A hundred years, *Player*! Somebody has to cut the next one.
    - The cliff on the Long Ridge is as good as I hoped. Now I am drawing gates for the stair. If things come up from the canyons, a stair needs a way to be shut.
    - A whole night on the Far Anchor, with Vosk and you, and the gnawers coming up off the ledge. I have never held a rope so hard. Vosk says I did well. He said it twice, so he means it.
    - The old walls in the War Camp Ruins showed me how the first Kragvar cut: rough and deep, every block leaning into the next. My gates will be built like that.
    - I can talk and carve at the same time. Mostly.
        - *Choice:* Who are you?
        - *Choice:* What is Vosk like?

    - Brakka, apprentice mason. Dorrek's daughter, which means everybody watches what I carve. Four years under Vosk now. I would rather cut something new than mend something old, and he would rather I mended.
    - Vosk ties every knot himself and trusts nobody else's. I was with him at dawn both times we found the far bridge ropes gnawed. He spliced them without a word, then sat a long while looking at the far side.
    - The boys' lookout? I found it ages ago. Good wall, too: low, but they set the stones properly. I never told them I knew. Don't you tell them either.
    - Mind the steps. Some of them are older than the songs.
